home.partnersIntro: DYNATECH serves as the exclusive gateway between Middle Eastern markets and two of Europe’s leading industrial technology organizations: FFT Produktionssysteme GmbH and Composites United. Through these partnerships, DYNATECH enables companies and institutions across the region to access advanced manufacturing systems, lightweight material technologies, automation solutions, and industrial development expertise directly from Europe.

sectors.description: The DYNATECH Automotive Hub is a next-generation destination combining electric mobility, automotive services, technical operations, training, and infrastructure within one integrated environment. Designed as a fully operational ecosystem, the hub includes EV and ICE servicing, body shop operations, training facilities, administration spaces, technical workshops, vehicle storage, and showroom operations.
